title: All the AI agents that can live in your text messages
slides: Can an AI agent live in your texts?
Text-message agents act on your behalf directly
They reply, book, and pay without opening apps
Your bank and calendar become chat commands
Text one task to an agent this week
thread_text:
1. Your AI Now Lives in Texts

A new wave of agents can read your messages and act without you opening a single app. They reply, book, and pay on your behalf.

2. No App, Just Chat

These text-message agents operate directly inside your existing conversations. You don't download anything new — you just text a number.

3. Booking and Paying by Text

They can schedule appointments, reserve tables, and send payments. All it takes is a single message from you.

4. Bank and Calendar as Commands

Your financial and scheduling data becomes just another chat input. The agent treats your bank and calendar like programmable endpoints.

5. Try One Task This Week

Send a text to an agent to book a haircut or pay a bill. If it fails, you've lost nothing but a few seconds.
